values.note: Counts on training rows. A missing-value marker is imputed by the model, with an indicator column for a numeric variable.

duplicates.definition: rows identical on every column except the target

values.question: Are there missing cells, repeated rows, rare categories, or values outside their possible range in the development rows?
values.note: Structural reading of the development rows: the target is not read, and nothing here is a rate or an association. A range is checked only against a range the case declares.

values.question: Does any single feature, on its own, predict the target so well that its availability at the prediction moment should be questioned?
values.note: Each feature alone, scored out of fold on the training rows. A high value only raises a question about when the value is known; it never keeps or drops a feature, and a legitimate feature may score high.

null_band.note: The band is the range of the same figure after shuffling the target among the training rows 19 times (fixed seed): what chance alone draws. A pattern inside it is not distinguishable from chance; one above every shuffle happens by chance about once in 20 looks.
